show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Joanne Wilson - Angel Investing and Trend Spotting - [Invest Like the Best, EP.65]
summary: Since then, she’s invested in more than 90 companies and been pitched by countless more. She is an instantly likeable person, you can literally tell in 10 seconds you are going to have a great conversation, so it’s no surprise that part of what makes her unique among angels is a very close relationship with many of the founders she backs. We talk about the personality traits of entrepreneurs, Joanne’s evolving investment style, her focus on female founders, fashion, business models, restaurants and a lot more.

thesis: Joanne Wilson argues that successful entrepreneurs possess a specific personality type characterized by a comfort with risk and a big-picture perspective that allows them to identify voids in the market. She also suggests that the ability to spot emerging trends is a mixture of innate talent and cultivated habits, such as consuming vast amounts of information and maintaining a gut feeling for what is coming next.
